The '''Cardellia system''' was a part of the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Cardellian mint]]s|system=Cardellia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the consumables known as [[Cardellian mint]]s.<ref name="Creatures">{{WEGCite|story=A Sure Bet|book=Creatures of the Galaxy}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Cardellia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-7.<ref name="TEA" />
